files.summary: Create, validation, SSRF and blocklist end-to-end tests
Redirect, analytics, expiry and rate limit end-to-end tests

note: Proposed tests (11 [Fact] method(s)). Executed only by the orchestrator's sandbox run. Proposal only; not compiled or run. Not covered by code here: the hostname-resolving-to-private DNS check (needs a resolver seam; UrlValidator uses Dns directly, so tests disable DNS to stay deterministic), the p95 load test and the slow-sink latency check (needs a load script and an injectable sink). Redirect rate limiting is keyed on remote IP, so per-client isolation is tested on creation through X-Client-Id. The 'Retry-After' header lookup assumes it is exposed in response headers.
